headline: Gower Coast Access and Rhossili Parking
reservation: Entry to the beach and cliff paths is open without reservations, though the National Trust car park at Rhossili village serves as the primary access point. While no permit is required for the bay, visitors should check tide times locally for safe access to landmarks. Always verify current parking availability and facility status with the National Trust before travel.

days.title: Gower Cliffs and Golden Sands

stops.name: Rhossili Bay
stops.detail: Walk the three-mile sandy shore to view the 1887 wreck of the Helvetia at low tide or surf the Atlantic swell.

days.driving: Allow 45-60 minutes from Swansea; conditions vary on narrow peninsula roads.
days.note: Beach access is via a steep path with steps; use the gravel cliff-top path for a level alternative.

intel.title: Village Facilities
intel.text: The main car park in Rhossili village includes accessible toilets and a changing places facility. Space is limited during peak summer periods.

intel.title: Beach Descent
intel.text: The path to the sand involves many steps and is not wheelchair accessible. The route toward the Coastwatch Centre offers a flatter alternative for viewing Worm's Head.

intel.title: Tidal Windows
intel.text: The wreck of the Helvetia is only visible at low tide. Monitor local tide tables if you plan to walk the full length of the three-mile shore.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Evidence does not specify mobile signal strength at the peninsula's end. Plan for potential gaps in data coverage near the cliffs.

intel.title: Local Supplies
intel.text: Fuel availability in Rhossili village is not documented in official sources. Drivers should ensure adequate fuel before leaving the Swansea area.

plan.arrival: Collect your vehicle in Swansea and head west toward the SA3 1PP postcode. Check in at the National Trust car park before heading to the cliff-top views.
plan.vehicle: Suitable for cars; check size restrictions for RVs on the narrow village roads leading to the bay.
plan.goldenHour: Cliff-top views overlooking Worm's Head, particularly scenic during the late afternoon sun.
